purpose: Evaluate the shipped BBY Q 0 components and end-to-end Android dispatch; plan the next stage without tuning product sources or released weights
probes: new vocabulary and order-sensitive encoder collisions
android: Independent new conversations scored on actual PersonalEngine responses; existing 31 regression assertions remain required. Report functional failures instead of editing expectations or product behavior to pass.
evaluation: Separate scores for each task, exact-match language, abstention and task completion; retain every failure and parameter identities. No aggregate intelligence percentage.
selection: No training, checkpoint selection, or bug fixing during the assessment. Throwaway state only. Published tests are already open and are labeled regression checks.
limits: Synthetic tasks and a finite language grammar
No physical-phone or real sensor measurement
Classical execution of the project's quantum circuits
